title: SSC GD Constable 2026 Marks / Score Card & Final Answer Key
title_hi: एसएससी जीडी कांस्टेबल 2026 मार्क्स और फाइनल उत्तर कुंजी
short_info: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has uploaded the Marks and Score Card for Constable (GD) in Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs), SSF, and Rifleman (GD) in Assam Rifles Examination, 2026. All candidates who appeared in the examination can check their marks using their Registration Number and Password.

age_limit.notes: Age relaxation as per SSC GD Constable Recruitment Rules.

vacancy_details.eligibility: Class 10th (High School) Exam Passed from Any Recognized Board in India.

title: UPSSSC Sports Directorate Main Exam 2026 Online Form for 108 Post
title_hi: यूपीएसएसएससी खेल निदेशालय मुख्य परीक्षा 2026 ऑनलाइन आवेदन (108 पद)
department: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC)
short_info: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) Advt No. 22-Exam/2026 has released recruitment notification for 108 posts in Directorate of Sports, UP. Candidates shortlisted based on UPSSSC PET 2025 Score can apply online from 14/10/2026 to 04/11/2026.

age_limit.notes: Age as on 01/07/2026. Age relaxation extra as per UP Govt rules.

vacancy_details.eligibility: UPSSSC PET 2025 Score Card + Bachelor Degree in Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or Diploma with Sports Achievement.

title: UPSSSC Junior Assistant 2026 Admit Card (Advt No. 12-Exam/2024)
department: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC)
short_info: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Written Exam Admit Card for Junior Assistant, Junior Clerk, and Assistant Grade-III recruitment (Advt No. 12-Exam/2024 for 5512 posts).

vacancy_details.eligibility: 12th Intermediate with CCC Exam & Hindi Typing 25 WPM, English 30 WPM.

title: Railway RRB NTPC Graduate & Undergraduate Level Online Form 2026
title_hi: रेलवे आरआरबी एनटीपीसी स्नातक एवं 12वीं स्तर भर्ती 2026
short_info: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) Centralized Employment Notice CEN 05/2024 & CEN 06/2024 has invited online applications for 11,558 Posts of Station Master, Goods Train Manager, Senior Clerk, Accounts Clerk, and Commercial cum Ticket Clerk across all Indian Railway zones.

age_limit.notes: 3 years relaxation given due to Covid pandemic.

vacancy_details.post_name: Graduate Posts (Station Master, Goods Guard, Senior Clerk)
vacancy_details.eligibility: Bachelor Degree in Any Stream from a Recognized University.

title_hi: बिहार बीपीएससी शिक्षक भर्ती टीआरई 4.0 ऑनलाइन फॉर्म 2026

Bachelor / Master Degree in Subject + B.Ed + Bihar STET.

title: NTA All India Sainik Schools AISSEE 2027 Admission Online Form

title: SSC CHSL 10+2 Tier I & Tier II Revised Exam Syllabus 2026 PDF
title_hi: एसएससी सीएचएसएल 10+2 टियर 1 एवं 2 संशोधित पाठ्यक्रम 2026
short_info: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the detailed revised syllabus and exam pattern for Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination. Tier 1 consists of 100 questions (200 marks) and Tier 2 has 2 sessions including Computer Knowledge & Skill/Typing test.

title: BSF Head Constable RO / RM Written Exam Answer Key 2026
title_hi: बीएसएफ हेड कांस्टेबल आरओ / आरएम उत्तर कुंजी 2026
short_info: Border Security Force (BSF) has released the provisional answer keys for the post of Head Constable (Radio Operator) and Head Constable (Radio Mechanic). Candidates can raise objections online by paying the requisite fee.

vacancy_details.eligibility: 10+2 with 60% in PCM or 10th with 2 Year ITI.

title: UP Police Constable 60,244 Post Final Result & Cutoff 2026
title_hi: यूपी पुलिस कांस्टेबल 60,244 पद फाइनल रिजल्ट और कटऑफ

title: Indian Air Force Airman Medical Assistant Rally 2026
